terminals.name: celery-worker
terminals.command: cd backend && . .venv/bin/activate && QUEUES=$(python scripts_print_celery_queues.py) && celery -A app.workers.celery_app worker --beat --queues "${QUEUES:-cdp,celery,default,intel,ml,rules,sync}" --schedule /tmp/celerybeat-schedule --loglevel info --concurrency 2
